test_title: PYST 35: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A and B complete a work in 18 days. If A alone can do it in 24 days, then B alone can do one-fourth of the same work in_______ days.
solution:
**Given:**

A + B = 18 days

A alone = 24 days

**Formula used:**

Work rate = 1 / Time

**Calculation:**

A's 1 day work = 1/24

(A + B)'s 1 day work = 1/18

⇒ B's 1 day work = 1/18 − 1/24

⇒ B's 1 day work = (4 − 3) / 72 = 1/72

B alone can do full work in 72 days

1/4 work ⇒ 72 × 1/4 = 18 days

**∴ B alone can do 1/4 work in 18 days.**
